subject.title: fix(reply): strip leaked current-message scaffolding and (no output) placeholders

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's shared reply sanitizer and `empty-tool-output` skip semantics once the current broad CI failures are clean or triaged?
rationale: The patch fixes a concrete leak but changes the shared final-delivery filter for all channels, so automation should not decide the acceptable over-stripping boundary on its own.

options.title: Land after clean checks
options.body: Rerun or triage the two broad failing shards, then merge if the shared sanitizer and skip-reason contract is acceptable.

options.title: Request live Telegram proof
options.body: Ask for a short Telegram Desktop proof if visible transport confirmation is required in addition to the production-function terminal proof.

options.title: Pause for narrower semantics
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a different scaffold-marker contract or owner boundary before changing shared delivery behavior.

recommendation.title: Land after clean checks
recommendation.body: Rerun or triage the two broad failing shards, then merge if the shared sanitizer and skip-reason contract is acceptable.
